Container.Name: teslamate-mcp
Container.Overview:
Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes your TeslaMate PostgreSQL database to AI assistants (Claude, Cursor, ...) over streamable HTTP. 57 tools (47 predefined analytics queries + run_sql + get_database_schema + 8 interactive MCP Apps charts), 11 prompts, resources.
Requires a running TeslaMate + PostgreSQL stack. Endpoint: http://[IP]:[PORT:8888]/mcp - Health: http://[IP]:[PORT:8888]/health Protect the endpoint with AUTH_TOKEN (bearer auth) before exposing it through a Cloudflare Tunnel / MCP Server Portal.
Container.Requires: TeslaMate and its PostgreSQL database must already be running.

Config.Name: MCP HTTP port
Config.Description: Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint (/mcp) and liveness probe (/health).

Config.Name: DATABASE_URL
Config.Description: PostgreSQL connection string for the TeslaMate database. Use the Unraid host IP and the credentials from your TeslaMate PostgreSQL container. Use a SELECT-only role (e.g. teslamate_ro), not the teslamate superuser - see SECURITY.md.

Config.Name: AUTH_TOKEN
Config.Description: Bearer token protecting /mcp. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32 (or `teslamate-mcp gen-token`). Leave empty ONLY for LAN-only unauthenticated use - never when exposed via tunnel.

Config.Name: CF_ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN
Config.Description: Optional. Cloudflare Access team domain (e.g. myteam.cloudflareaccess.com). With CF_ACCESS_AUD, accepts requests authenticated by Cloudflare Access - needed to connect claude.ai directly (without the MCP portal) so MCP Apps charts render.

Config.Name: CF_ACCESS_AUD
Config.Description: Optional. Application Audience (AUD) tag of the Cloudflare Access application protecting the direct hostname. Set together with CF_ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.

Config.Name: MAP_TILES
Config.Description: Draw a low-detail basemap (Esri gray canvas tiles) under the route, trip, and places maps. Tiles are fetched by the viewer's browser and reveal the rough area viewed; set false to keep the maps fully offline.

Config.Name: LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: Python log level (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR).

Config.Name: QUERY_TIMEOUT_MS
Config.Description: statement_timeout (ms) applied to run_sql custom queries.

Config.Name: CUSTOM_SQL_ROW_LIMIT
Config.Description: Most rows run_sql returns, whatever LIMIT the query has.
